about: The host contract suite (docs/architecture/hosts.md, "The rules every host keeps"). One set of scenarios, run against the server (server/hostcontract_test.go, its upstream the bucket) and the browser (web/src/uis/host-contract.test.mjs, its upstream the server). Each step sets what the upstream does, and names what the host must say of the head it serves. `answers` with `head`: the upstream answers, and its head is that document. `silent`: the upstream does not answer. `slow`: the upstream answers after the host's time limit. `expect.state`: `current` (an answer the upstream confirmed now), `stale` (the host's copy, labelled with its age), or `failed` (the host holds no copy, and says the read failed). `expect.as_of`: `last-answer` — the age is when the upstream last answered, never the time of the host's own read.

scenarios.name: a head moves while the host holds a copy
